claim: On Dec. 24, 1968 Apollo 8's crew, the first humans to orbit the Moon, saw Earth rise unplanned, and Bill Anders's color photo became an icon.

beats.caption: 1968: THE MOON TRIP
beats.vo: They flew to the Moon. They found Earth.

beats.caption: DEC. 21, 1968
beats.vo: December 21st, 1968. Apollo 8 rides a Saturn V toward the Moon.

beats.caption: FIRST IN LUNAR ORBIT
beats.vo: On Christmas Eve, Borman, Lovell, and Anders become the first humans to orbit it.

beats.caption: ORBIT NUMBER 4
beats.vo: Fourth time around, Anders looks out his window. Earth is rising! It wasn't on the schedule.

beats.caption: EARTHRISE
beats.vo: They scrambled for color film. Anders took three photos. One became an icon of the century.

sources.text: NASA, Apollo 8 Astronaut Bill Anders Captures Earthrise: https://www.nasa.gov/image-article/apollo-8-astronaut-bill-anders-captures-earthrise/
